note: Machine-readable breakdown of the U.S. electricity series for 2026 (Form EIA-930 daily-region-data, Eastern timezone aggregation, MWh). Principle: observations are stored at the finest unit the source publishes; the page shows the Lower 48 aggregate; breakdowns live only in JSON, split by year. regions = the 13 EIA regions that partition the Lower 48 (their sum is US48); balancing_authorities = every balancing authority the API returned. value_status provisional/final as in power_us.json.
